distribution.narrative: Baseline records support Heilongjiang; Wang et al. (2021) adds Inner Mongolia from Chifeng/Baiyinaobao. The current synthesis retains both rather than replacing the historical distribution with the 2021 sampling subset.

host_note: Baseline host Picea koraiensis is retained; Wang et al. (2021) adds Picea mongolica.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips duplicatus (Sahlberg, 1836).
